items.title: CVE-2026-12345: Microsoft Exchange Server RCE under active exploitation
items.summary: A critical remote-code-execution vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server is being exploited in the wild by multiple threat actors. CISA has added the flaw to the KEV catalog and federal agencies must remediate within 7 days. Patches are available from Microsoft. Indicators of compromise include suspicious PowerShell child processes under w3wp.exe and outbound connections to known C2 infrastructure.

related_sources.title: Microsoft releases out-of-band patch for Exchange RCE
Exchange zero-day exploited in attacks on financial firms

items.title: Volt Typhoon expands campaign targeting US critical infrastructure
items.summary: Unit 42 researchers report continued targeting of US energy, water, and transportation sectors by the China-nexus Volt Typhoon group. The campaign uses living-off-the-land techniques and compromised SOHO routers as operational relay boxes. New TTPs include abuse of legitimate cloud services for C2 and credential theft via WMIC.

related_sources.title: Volt Typhoon: new tools, same playbook

items.title: CVE-2026-23456: Fortinet FortiOS authentication bypass - public PoC released
items.summary: Fortinet has disclosed a critical authentication bypass affecting FortiOS and FortiProxy. A public proof-of-concept exploit has been released on GitHub. Fortinet recommends immediate patching; mitigations include disabling the SSL-VPN web mode if patching is not feasible. The flaw is rated CVSS 9.6.

items.title: Cisco Talos uncovers new ransomware-as-a-service operation 'Helix'
items.summary: Talos has identified a new RaaS operation dubbed Helix actively targeting healthcare and manufacturing organizations in North America and Europe. The operators use stolen credentials and exploit unpatched VPN appliances for initial access. Average ransom demands are between $1.2M and $4M.

items.title: CVE-2026-34567: Google Chrome V8 type-confusion zero-day patched
items.summary: Google has released an emergency Chrome update fixing a type-confusion vulnerability in the V8 JavaScript engine. The flaw was reported by Google TAG and is being exploited in targeted attacks. Users should update to version 134.0.6998.88 or later immediately.

items.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday May 2026 fixes 78 vulnerabilities, 5 zero-days
items.summary: Microsoft's May 2026 Patch Tuesday addresses 78 vulnerabilities including 5 zero-day flaws. Affected products span Windows, Office, Edge, and Azure. Administrators should prioritize CVE-2026-45678 (Windows Kernel EoP) and CVE-2026-45679 (SharePoint RCE) which are under active exploitation.

related_sources.title: Patch Tuesday: 78 fixes, 5 zero-days under attack

items.title: Phishing campaign abuses Microsoft Teams to deliver DarkGate malware
items.summary: A phishing campaign tracked since April is using external Microsoft Teams messages to deliver DarkGate loader to targets in the financial services sector across Europe. Attackers impersonate internal IT staff and lure users into running malicious AutoIT scripts.

items.title: Healthcare provider discloses ransomware breach affecting 2M patients
items.summary: A US-based regional healthcare network has disclosed a ransomware incident impacting personal and medical records of approximately 2 million patients. The attack reportedly involved exfiltration prior to encryption. The provider has restored most clinical systems from backups.
